nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name, set to SpaceX in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token symbol, set to SpaceX in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' holding token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 state variable '_totalSupply' holding the total token supply minted to the deployer.
Private mapping(address => uint) 'balances' storing token balances of each account.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) 'allowed' storing ERC20 allowances.
Constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and crediting balances[msg.sender].
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] (unsafe unchecked subtraction).
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view returning balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve(address spender, uint tokens) sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moves tokens from msg.sender using SafeMath safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moves tokens and decrements allowance without an explicit allowance sufficiency check.
SafeMath safeAdd(uint a, uint b) returning a+b with an overflow require check.
SafeMath safeSub(uint a, uint b) returning a-b with an underflow require check.
SafeMath safeMul(uint a, uint b) returning a*b with an overflow require check.
SafeMath safeDiv(uint a, uint b) returning a/b with a division-by-zero require check.
Attacker-controlled msg.sender used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender throughout the token contract.
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd; potential arithmetic overflow/underflow if the require guard is bypassed.
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub; potential arithmetic underflow in balance/allowance updates.
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul; potential arithmetic overflow.
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv; potential division by zero if b is not validated.
Raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() without SafeMath, potential arithmetic underflow.
Allowance spending path in transferFrom: allowed[from][msg.sender] is decremented without an explicit access-control allowance check.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient of the initial supply assigned to balances in the constructor.
msg.sender keys the allowed mapping written by approve.
msg.sender identifies the balance debited and credited in transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender when decrementing allowed in transferFrom.
Constructor assigns the fixed initial value to _totalSupply.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the total supply.
transferFrom spends and mutates the allowed mapping without an explicit allowance sufficiency/authorization check.
approve writes the spender allowance into allowed.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
transferFrom writes updated balances for from and to.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply in the returned expression.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in the returned expression.
transfer delegates the balance debits to the inherited SafeMath safeSub external-style call.
transfer delegates the balance credits to the inherited SafeMath safeAdd external-style call.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance debits to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates the recipient balance credit to safeAdd.
safeAdd computes c = a + b, the raw unchecked addition operation.
safeSub computes c = a - b, the raw subtraction operation.
safeMul computes c = a * b, the raw multiplication operation.
safeDiv computes c = a / b, the raw division operation.
totalSupply performs an unguarded subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
transferFrom reaches the allowance-decrement path without validating that the spender was authorized for the amount.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the nested allowed mapping in allowance.
tokenOwner parameter indexes balances in balanceOf.
spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
to parameter is the recipient balance key updated by transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
from parameter is the source account spent by transferFrom.
to parameter is the destination account credited by transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
Parameter a flows into safeAdd's addition operand.
Parameter b flows into safeAdd's addition operand.
Parameter a flows into safeSub's subtraction operand.
Parameter b flows into safeSub's subtraction operand.
Parameter a flows into safeMul's multiplication operand.
Parameter b flows into safeMul's multiplication operand.
Parameter a flows into safeDiv's division operand.
Parameter b flows into safeDiv's division operand.
Result of a + b is stored in local c of safeAdd.
Result of a - b is stored in local c of safeSub.
Result of a * b is stored in local c of safeMul.
Result of a / b is stored in local c of safeDiv.
balanceOf assigns balances[tokenOwner] to its local return variable balance.
allowance assigns allowed[tokenOwner][spender] to its local return variable remaining.
approve sets and returns the local success flag.
transfer sets and returns the local success flag.
transferFrom sets and returns the local success flag.
